title: Hailey Bieber's 30-Carat Choker and 9 More Diamond Looks From the Grammys
text: Celebrity Jewelry Hailey Bieber’s 30-Carat Choker and 9 More Diamond Looks From the Grammys The best celebrity diamond jewelry from music’s biggest night. Published 1 week ago on February 1, 2026 By Beth Bernstein Share Tweet SURE THERE WERE some outrageous and over-the-top jewelry one would expect to see at music’s most important nights. But the 2026 Grammys were more subdued than we have seen in the past. Instead, the brightest stars being honored, performing or presenting followed the prior awards red carpet trend towards glittering diamonds that ranged from those that could be more dramatic, glamorous looks to those that can be worn for any occasion. Here were some of the best diamond jewels of the evening — some of which stores could add to their inventory to elevate or act as staples for their customer’s jewelry wardrobes. Embed from Getty Images Justin and Hailey Bieber wore classic black as the backdrop for diamonds. Hailey Bieber was perhaps my favorite look of the evening in a hardware-looking choker with a 30-carat center diamond and matching earrings from Lorraine Schwartz, while Justin also sparkled in a Lorraine Schwartz diamond necklace. Embed from Getty Images Chrissy Teigen was one of the many celebrities who wore Chopard jewelry. She donned dramatic elongated diamond earrings. Embed from Getty Images Paris Hilton shone in Chopard front-facing hoop earrings, diamond bracelet and diamond ring. Embed from Getty Images Embed from Getty Images Sabrina Carpenter went for an ultra-feminine look in an embroidered jeweled Valentino gown and Chopard diamond drop earrings, eternity band, and a cushion-cut diamond ring. Embed from Getty Images Charlotte Lawrence went for a more modern look in black shades, and dress and Messika High Jewelry necklace with a center pear-shaped diamond and Messika’s Fiery High Jewelry earrings. Embed from Getty Images Madison Beer was another celebrity who wore a black gown. She complemented it with EFFY Jewelry diamond drop earrings and a diamond bracelet, which I will update once I find out who designed it. These pieces could act as the essentials of any jewelry wardrobe. Embed from Getty Images Singer, songwriter, music producer and the creative director of Louis Vuitton Men’s collection Pharrell Williams layered rivière diamond necklaces and huge diamond stud earrings. Another one of my favorite looks of the evening. Embed from Getty Images Olivia Dean was the recipient of the Best New Artist award and accepted wearing a Chanel gown with Cartier dangling diamond earrings and bracelet. Embed from Getty Images Addison Rae wore double drop diamond earrings. These are staples that can be worn anywhere, any time of the day and for every occasion.
